title: VMM 100KM — World Trail Majors — official race page
claims: The page titles the race 'VMM 100KM - WORLD TRAIL MAJORS' and states that the 100km is one of the two World Trail Majors series distances at VMM, together with the 50km.
The 100km is listed at 101 km with 5,500 m of elevation gain.
Cut-off times are 12:00 at CP Topas Ecolodge, 21:00 at CP3, 00:00 on Sunday at CP4, 02:00 at CP5, 05:00 at CP6, 06:30 at CP7 and 09:00 at the finish.
The page says '2027 race dates: to be updated' and gives no start time for the 100km.
The start is Sapa Square, the finish is Topas Ecolodge, bib collection is at Sapa Square and runners must pick up their own bib.
Runners may hand in three bags at the start — one finish bag, one for CP2 and one for CP4 — and the CP2 and CP4 bags are returned to the Sapa Expo area on Sunday morning.

The course description names a new route after CP M2 along the mountainside above the Muong Hoa valley, a single-track alternative climb to Mount Silverstone, and an updated CP1-CP2 climb that extends higher up the mountainside.
The race is badged as a World Trail Majors race, a 4-point ITRA qualifying race, an ITRA National League race, a 100K UTMB Index race and a Western States 2027 qualifying race.

Entry requires at least one previously completed chip-timed 50km+ ultra mountain race with significant elevation, excluding loop and virtual races, and the qualifying result must be submitted by 30 days before race day.
Outside assistance is permitted for the 100km and 100 miles only, from one supporter carrying a supporter card, at the designated checkpoints.
The age limit is 18 on race day.
The course runs from Sapa town over Ham Rong Mountain, Mount Silverstone, the Ban Moi valley, Topas Ecolodge, Lao Chai, O Quy Ho, Cow Mountain and Ta Phin to the Topas Ecolodge finish.
